description: This is a JUnit test class for the AuthorRepository in a Spring Boot project. It tests CRUD operations such as findAll, delete, and deleteAll for the Author entity within the data access layer.

classes.name: AuthorRepositoryTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing data access methods in AuthorRepository.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Deletes all authors before each test to ensure a clean test environment.

methods.name: canFindAll
methods.description: Tests that all saved authors can be retrieved successfully.

methods.name: canDeleteIfExists
methods.description: Tests that an author can be deleted if they exist.

methods.name: canDeleteAll
methods.description: Tests that all authors can be deleted at once.
